verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no in-product feature that uses AI to generate insights or suggestions from a user's data. AI Overview is a metrics dashboard about AI calls, not AI-generated analysis. The MCP server and CLI let external coding agents read Inngest data, which is an adjacent building block rather than in-product AI insight.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
